newsitem.title: USA: N.J. agency says spurred $722 mln of investments.
newsitem.headline: N.J. agency says spurred $722 mln of investments.

text.p: The New Jersey Economic Development Authority said Tuesday its deals during the first nine months of 1996 generated about $722 million of investments in the state.

The agency reported at its monthly board meeting that from Jan 1 through Sept 30, the EDA issued bonds, loans and guarantees totaling $476 million to enable 178 investments by the private sector and non-profit organizations totaling $722 million.
"These EDA-backed projects are creating 7,500 construction jobs and nearly 2,500 permanent jobs," said Commerce Commissioner Gualberto Medina. "And they will help keep 5,500 jobs here in New Jersey."
